title: Health Insurance
description: Travel and health insurance designed for location-independent workers.

resources.name: SafetyWing
resources.description: ~$45/mo. Subscription-based travel medical insurance up to $250K. Pay monthly, cancel anytime. Ages 18–69.

resources.name: Genki
resources.description: ~$65/mo. EU-based health insurance with mental health coverage included. €1M max. Monthly cancellation. Ages 18–65.

resources.name: World Nomads
resources.description: ~$100/mo. Adventure sports + gear coverage. Trip cancellation, 24/7 emergency assistance. Ages 18–70.

resources.name: Passport Card
resources.description: ~$120/mo. No out-of-pocket debit card, real-time claims, no forms. Telemedicine included. Ages 18–55.

resources.name: Allianz Care
resources.description: ~$180/mo. Premium full-coverage plan with repatriation. Pre-existing conditions after waiting period. Ages 18–75.

resources.name: Cigna Global
resources.description: ~$200/mo. Full international health insurance with family plans, dental add-on, and preventive care. Ages 18–75.

resources.name: Insured Nomads
resources.description: Travel medical + telemedicine + mental health support. Includes crisis response.
